attBesluta.text: Love these chairs! They are super stylish plus so comfortable, PLUS the fold up and you can store them away! Wow! So high quality!
foarte multumit de setul de doua scaune pliabile! produs de calitate si livrare ok!
Déjà montée, excellente qualité, dossier et assise très confortable, pliable se range facilement.

These high-quality folding chairs are much more presentable than the average cheap, metal folding chairs that are often offered when an 'extra' seat is needed. They arrive well packaged, fully assembled (yay!), and include adhesive-backed felt squares for the bottom of all the chair legs. The seats themselves are comfortable to sit in, and the chairs fold easily - so great functionality; I chose the walnut wood with the beige cushion, and they are very attractive. I would recommend this item.

These are pretty nice. They look good, like you could just leave them out all the time. I got these because I was looking for some I could use in my studio when I have guests, but put away when just myself. They are very sturdy, padding is thick and they look nice.

Hard when you sit on them - not really cushiony!! But they are for our motorhome and they work well since they fold. I used scotchguard on the fabric too. I would recommend for occasional use not every day use!
